chapter_title: Concerning the Ad[vent] of the Apostle.
chapter_note: This chapter is dominated by later layers: dialogue framing, apostolic/church succession doctrine, and extended NT-derived Jesus/Paraclete material. Only small fragments (¶24–25) preserve schematic cosmological “mystery” content that stays inside the Light–Darkness system (depths/heights, war, mingling, ships, Adam). Even these appear embedded in Mani’s autobiographical Paraclete-revelation rhetoric, so they are extracted as MIXED rather than CORE.

paragraphs.temporal_note: Dialogue setup: disciples questioning; hagiographic container language. No cosmological system exposition.
Dialogue attribution (“The apostle says… I will recount…”). This is compilation framing, not substrate.
Direct address (“O my beloved ones”) and analogy applied to “apostles” and “churches” (institutional-historical referents), not cosmos→cosmos mapping.
Continuation of the farmer/gardener exemplum as application to apostolic activity; natural imagery is used to explain institutional succession, not cosmic architecture.
Institutional categories (elect/catechumens) and church-formation language; flagged as editorial extension and reads as ecclesial application.
Apostle/church ‘forms’ made free—still oriented to apostolic institution; not impersonal cosmological mechanics.
Returns to the farmer analogy applied to apostolic labour/harvest; no independent cosmic degree-structure.
Programmatic claim about apostles ‘from the beginning of the moulding of humanity’—salvation-history framing, not the old systematic cosmology.
Mythic-hagiographic account of an apostle leaving/assisting his church as helper/guardian; still institution-facing, not cosmos→cosmos correspondences.
Merchant simile applied to the apostle’s joy/rest; exemplum rhetoric, not substrate mapping.
Tree/fruits and ceaseless labour analogy explicitly used to justify uninterrupted apostolic succession; institutional doctrine rather than cosmological system description.
Apostolic succession plus ‘church’ ascent/descent; embedded salvation-history logic and Christianized vocabulary (‘sin’) rather than impersonal cosmic mechanics.
Enumerated salvation-history chain of apostles (Sethel… Buddha… Zarathustra… Jesus). This is historiographic/gnostic framing, not the oldest correspondential substrate.
NT-derived Jesus narrative (Jews, twelve/seventy-two, Judas, Satan). Entry vector is Gospel/NT tradition.
Passion/resurrection sequence in explicit NT narrative form (cross, grave, three days, breathing Spirit). Later Christian overlay.
Still within the Jesus-apostles dossier; dependent on the NT/apostolic narrative stream.
Paul as a named apostolic figure and reinforcement of Jesus’ apostles—NT figure/narrative anchor.
Moralizing decline theme (‘broad road’ vs ‘narrow’) in exhortational register; not cosmological mechanism.
Narrative about a ‘righteous man’ in the last church and the church perishing—salvation-history framing, not core cosmology.
Brief simile (‘tree… plucked… without fruit’) functioning as rhetorical bridge in the church-history narrative.
Explicit Paraclete saying attributed to the saviour (‘Just like the saviour said…’), from Johannine tradition.
Paraclete speech paraphrasing John (upbraid the world concerning sin/righteousness/judgement). Christian overlay.
Continues the Paraclete-from-Jesus-to-now timeline; even with month imagery, the conceptual entry is Johannine/Christian synthesis.

paragraphs.core_text: the hidden mystery, the one that is hidden from the worlds and the generations, the mystery of the depths and the heights. He unveiled to me the mystery of the Light and the Darkness; the mystery of the calamity of conflict, and the war, and the great [...], the battle that the Darkness spread about. Afterwards, he unveiled to me also: How the Light [...] the Darkness, through their mingling this universe was set up [...]
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed Mani-specific autobiographical/hagiographic scaffolding anchoring the revelation to particular kings/years and to the Paraclete’s descent to Mani (e.g., ‘in the years of Artabanus… Ardashir… the living Paraclete came down to me. He spoke with me.’). Retained only the cosmological mystery-content that stays within the Light–Darkness system (depths/heights, conflict/war, mingling and universe-setup).
paragraphs.temporal_note: Cosmic-system vocabulary and mechanics (Depths/Heights; Light vs Darkness; war; mingling establishing the universe) suggest an older teaching summary, but it is embedded in later first-person Paraclete-revelation narrative, requiring extraction.

paragraphs.core_text: the way that the ships were constructed; to enable the gods of Light to be in them, to purify the Light from creation. Conversely, the dregs and the effluent [...] to the abyss. The mystery of the fashioning of Adam, the first man. Also, the mystery of the tree of knowledge, which Adam ate from; his eyes saw.
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed the institutional/apostolic add-on list that crosses from cosmos→cosmos into cosmos→church categories: ‘the mystery of the apostles… choose the churches… the elect… the catechumens… the sinners…’ (editorial application/institutional catalogue appended to the cosmological mysteries).
paragraphs.temporal_note: Begins with internal cosmological mechanism (ships purifying Light; dregs to abyss; Adam; tree of knowledge) characteristic of systematic Manichaean cosmology, then pivots into church-institution taxonomy (elect/catechumens), indicating a later graft.
Totalizing self-claim (‘seen the totality… single body… single Spirit’) functions as hagiographic climax and identity assertion, not impersonal substrate exposition.
Missionary itinerary and ‘good election’—biographical/apostolate narrative.
Historical travelogue with kings/regions and honor by Shapur—hagiographic biography layer.
Self-authorization (‘I have chosen you… holy church… not one among the apostles…’) and eschatological claim; community-facing and promotional.
Meta-textual authorial claim about having written books and repeating the lesson; compilation/teacherly frame.
Formulaic closing response: disciples rejoice, thank, and confess Mani as Paraclete—classic hagiographic closure.
